```{r}
library(tidyverse)
file.exists("WVS_Time_Series_1981-2022_rds_v5_0.rds")


# These are the standardized "Integrated" codes for the Time Series file
target_vars <- c(
  "S002VS",    # Wave number
  "S003",    # Country Code (Numeric)
  "S020",    # Year
  "E114",    # Strong Leader (Equivalent to Q235 / V127)
  "E117",    # Army Rule (Equivalent to Q238 / V130)
  "E115",    # Having Experts Rule
  "E116",    # Expert Rule (Equivalent to Q237 / V129)
  "E018",    # Respect for Authority (Equivalent to Q45 / V69)
  "A042",    # Obedience (Equivalent to Q17 / V21)
  "E232",    # Religious Law (Equivalent to Q252 / V155)
  "E233",    # Army Takeover (Equivalent to Q253 / V156)
  "A124_02", # Neighbor: Race
  "A124_06", # Neighbor: Immigrants
  "A124_09", # Neighbor: Religion
  "A124_12"  # Neighbor: Language
)

# Read just the column names to see what we are dealing with
names(read_rds("WVS_Time_Series_1981-2022_rds_v5_0.rds")) %>% head(20)


# Load the file using the corrected path and selection
# Ensure the filename matches exactly what is in your folder
wvs_subset <- read_rds("WVS_Time_Series_1981-2022_rds_v5_0.rds") %>%
  select(all_of(target_vars))

# Check that it loaded correctly
head(wvs_subset)

```

```{r Creating the Authoritarian_values_index}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven) # For zap_labels

wvs_indexed <- wvs_subset %>%
  # --- STEP 1: STRIP LABELS ---
  # This converts all 'haven_labelled' columns into standard numbers
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(zap_labels(.)))) %>%
  
  # --- STEP 2: PERFORM RECODING ---
  mutate(
    # Political Systems (1=Very Good, 4=Very Bad)
    auth_leader  = (5 - E114) / 3, 
    auth_army    = (5 - E117) / 3,
    auth_experts = (5 - E116) / 3,
    
    # Values (Respect for Authority E018: 1=Good, 3=Bad)
    auth_respect = (4 - E018) / 2,
    
    # Obedience (A042: 1=Mentioned, 2=Not Mentioned)
    auth_obey    = ifelse(A042 == 1, 1, 0),
    
    # Democracy Definitions (1=Not Essential, 10=Essential)
    auth_relig_law = (E232 - 1) / 9,
    auth_army_take = (E233 - 1) / 9,
    
    # Neighbors (1=Mentioned/Reject, 2=Not Mentioned)
    reject_race  = ifelse(A124_02 == 1, 1, 0),
    reject_immig = ifelse(A124_06 == 1, 1, 0),
    reject_relig = ifelse(A124_09 == 1, 1, 0),
    reject_lang  = ifelse(A124_12 == 1, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  # --- STEP 3: CREATE THE INDEX ---
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(authoritarian_values_index = mean(c(
    auth_leader, auth_army, auth_experts, auth_respect, auth_obey,
    auth_relig_law, auth_army_take, reject_race, reject_immig, 
    reject_relig, reject_lang
  ), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()



# 1. Get a statistical summary of the new index
# This will show you the Min, Max, Mean, and how many NAs (missing values) exist
summary(wvs_indexed$authoritarian_values_index)

# 2. Visualize the distribution
# A successful index should usually look like a "bell curve" or be slightly skewed,
# ranging from 0 to 1.
hist(wvs_indexed$authoritarian_values_index, 
     main = "Distribution of Authoritarian Values Index",
     xlab = "Index Score (0 = Low, 1 = High)", 
     col = "steelblue", 
     breaks = 50)

# 3. Check the first few rows of just the components and the final index
wvs_indexed %>%
  select(S003, S020, auth_leader, auth_army, auth_experts, authoritarian_values_index) %>%
  head(10)
```


```{r Checking List of Countries in the Authoritarian_values_index}
# Install the missing package
install.packages("countrycode")

library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(countrycode)

# Recode and Create Index
wvs_indexed <- wvs_subset %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(zap_labels(.)))) %>%
  mutate(
    auth_leader    = (5 - E114) / 3, 
    auth_army      = (5 - E117) / 3,
    auth_experts   = (5 - E116) / 3,
    auth_respect   = (4 - E018) / 2,
    auth_obey      = ifelse(A042 == 1, 1, 0),
    auth_relig_law = (E232 - 1) / 9,
    auth_army_take = (E233 - 1) / 9,
    reject_race    = ifelse(A124_02 == 1, 1, 0),
    reject_immig   = ifelse(A124_06 == 1, 1, 0),
    reject_relig   = ifelse(A124_09 == 1, 1, 0),
    reject_lang    = ifelse(A124_12 == 1, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(authoritarian_values_index = mean(c(
    auth_leader, auth_army, auth_experts, auth_respect, auth_obey,
    auth_relig_law, auth_army_take, reject_race, reject_immig, 
    reject_relig, reject_lang
  ), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()


# Generate the list of countries
country_list <- wvs_indexed %>%
  filter(!is.na(authoritarian_values_index)) %>%
  distinct(S003) %>%
  mutate(country_name = countrycode(S003, origin = "iso3n", destination = "country.name")) %>%
  arrange(country_name)

# Display the list
print(country_list, n = Inf)

```


```{r Fixed Merging Script}
library(vdemdata)
library(dplyr)

# We use the 'any_of' trick here so R doesn't have to search through 
# the whole dataset multiple times.
target_vdem_vars <- c(
  "country_text_id", "year", "v2x_polyarchy", "v2cacamps",
  "v2xps_poly", "v2x_ps_poly", "v2mecenrat", "v2x_vdem_dsi"
)

# This is much faster than the standard pipe
vdem_indicators <- vdem[, names(vdem) %in% target_vdem_vars] %>%
  filter(year >= 1980) %>%
  rename(
    polarization = v2cacamps,
    # Standardize the names immediately
    party_strength = matches("v2xps_poly|v2x_ps_poly"),
    digital_proxy = matches("v2mecenrat|v2x_vdem_dsi")
  )

# Check the first few rows to ensure the names are standardized
head(vdem_indicators)

# This should return 2025 as the max year
max(vdem_indicators$year)



# 1. Surgical selection while the data is in the package environment
vdem_indicators <- vdemdata::vdem %>%
  filter(year >= 1980) %>%
  select(
    country_text_id, year, v2x_polyarchy, 
    polarization = v2cacamps,
    # Standardize the party/digital tags for v16
    party_strength = any_of(c("v2xps_poly", "v2x_ps_poly")),
    digital_proxy = any_of(c("v2mecenrat", "v2x_vdem_dsi", "v2x_dsi"))
  )

# 2. FORCE R to delete the master dataset from RAM
rm(vdem)
gc() # Garbage collection: frees up the memory for the regression
```



```{r Robust World Bank Loading (Chunked)}

# THIS IS CURRENTLY NOT WORKING


library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# ── GINI Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gini_path <- "GINI_DATA.csv"

if (file.exists(gini_path)) {
  gini_raw <- read_csv(
    gini_path,
    show_col_types  = FALSE,
    skip_empty_rows = TRUE
  )
  
  # ── Detect format: wide (World Bank) vs. long ─────────────────────────────
  # World Bank exports: "Country Name", "Country Code", "Indicator Name",
  # "Indicator Code", then year columns (e.g. 1960, 1961, ..., 2025).
  is_wide <- any(grepl("country.name", names(gini_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)) ||
    any(grepl("^\\d{4}$", names(gini_raw)))
  
  if (is_wide) {
    country_col <- names(gini_raw)[1]
    year_cols   <- names(gini_raw)[grepl("^\\d{4}$", names(gini_raw))]
    
    gini_data <- gini_raw %>%
      select(country = all_of(country_col), all_of(year_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols      = all_of(year_cols),
        names_to  = "year",
        values_to = "gini"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        year = as.integer(year),
        gini = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gini))
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(gini))
  } else {
    names(gini_raw) <- tolower(names(gini_raw))
    gini_col  <- intersect(c("gini", "gini_index", "gini_coefficient"), names(gini_raw))[1]
    gini_data <- gini_raw %>%
      rename(gini = all_of(gini_col)) %>%
      select(country, year, gini) %>%
      mutate(year = as.integer(year), gini = as.numeric(gini))
  }
  
  # ── Harmonise World Bank country names → WVS country names ─────────────────
  wb_to_wvs <- c(
    "United States"                        = "United States",
    "United Kingdom"                       = "United Kingdom",
    "Russian Federation"                   = "Russia",
    "Korea, Rep."                          = "South Korea",
    "Korea, Dem. People\u2019s Rep."      = "North Korea",
    "Iran, Islamic Rep."                   = "Iran",
    "Egypt, Arab Rep."                     = "Egypt",
    "Venezuela, RB"                        = "Venezuela",
    "Syrian Arab Republic"                 = "Syria",
    "Yemen, Rep."                          = "Yemen",
    "Congo, Dem. Rep."                     = "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
    "Congo, Rep."                          = "Republic of the Congo",
    "Gambia, The"                          = "Gambia",
    "Lao PDR"                              = "Laos",
    "West Bank and Gaza"                   = "Palestine",
    "Micronesia, Fed. Sts."                = "Micronesia",
    "Slovak Republic"                      = "Slovakia",
    "Czechia"                              = "Czech Republic",
    "Kyrgyz Republic"                      = "Kyrgyzstan",
    "Turkiye"                              = "Turkey",
    "Cote d\u2019Ivoire"                  = "Ivory Coast",
    "Cabo Verde"                           = "Cape Verde",
    "Eswatini"                             = "Swaziland",
    "North Macedonia"                      = "North Macedonia",
    "Bosnia and Herzegovina"               = "Bosnia and Herzegovina"
  )
  gini_data <- gini_data %>%
    mutate(country = dplyr::recode(country, !!!wb_to_wvs))
} else {
  # Synthetic Gini demo data keyed to the same countries & years as WVS
  set.seed(99)
  gini_countries <- c(
    "Denmark", "Sweden", "Belgium", "Norway", "Ireland", "France",
    "Mexico", "Brazil", "Venezuela", "Chile", "Argentina",
    "United States", "Canada", "Russia", "Finland", "Australia",
    "Qatar", "Vietnam", "China", "Sudan", "Iran", "Iraq",
    "Niger", "Israel", "Palestine", "Libya", "Bolivia",
    "Hungary", "Poland", "Romania", "Ukraine", "Italy",
    "United Kingdom", "Pakistan", "Mozambique"
  )
  gini_data <- expand.grid(
    country = gini_countries,
    year    = c(1994, 1999, 2004, 2009, 2014, 2020)
  ) %>%
    mutate(gini = round(runif(n(), 25, 65), 1))
}
```

```{r Pulling Other Economic Indicators}
# Pull other economic indicators
res_rents <- WDI(indicator = "NY.GDP.FRST.RT.ZS", start = 1980, end = 2025, extra = TRUE)
gni_data  <- WDI(indicator = "NY.GNP.PCAP.PP.CD", start = 1980, end = 2025, extra = TRUE)

# Combine locally
wb_data <- res_rents %>%
  select(iso3c, year, resource_rents = NY.GDP.FRST.RT.ZS) %>%
  left_join(select(gni_data, iso3c, year, gni_pc = NY.GNP.PCAP.PP.CD), by = c("iso3c", "year")) %>%
  left_join(select(gini_data, iso3c, year, gini = SI.POV.GINI), by = c("iso3c", "year"))

# Check if it worked
head(wb_data)

```



```{r Final Merge and Regression}

# THIS WONT WORK UNTIL GINI GETS PROPERLY LOADED INTO R

library(zoo)

# Clean WVS for duplicates before merging
wvs_clean <- wvs_indexed %>% 
  distinct(iso3c, S020, .keep_all = TRUE)

final_data <- vdem_indicators %>%
  inner_join(wb_data, by = c("country_text_id" = "iso3c", "year")) %>%
  inner_join(wvs_clean, by = c("country_text_id" = "iso3c", "year" = "S020")) %>%
  group_by(country_text_id) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(
    gini_filled = na.approx(gini, na.rm = FALSE),
    gini_filled = na.locf(gini_filled, na.rm = FALSE),
    resource_filled = na.approx(resource_rents, na.rm = FALSE),
    logged_wealth = log(gni_pc)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  drop_na(v2x_polyarchy, authoritarian_values_index, polarization, 
          digital_proxy, party_strength, logged_wealth)

# RUN REGRESSION
summary(lm(scale(v2x_polyarchy) ~ scale(polarization) + scale(resource_filled) + 
             scale(logged_wealth) + scale(gini_filled) + scale(digital_proxy) + 
             scale(party_strength) + scale(authoritarian_values_index), 
           data = final_data))

```
